scientific_integrity: Sharp bound proved by an explicit Caratheodory three-moment lemma, exact coefficient factorization, and attaining extremals; finite checker supplemental, no independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: One-variable normalized starlike functions, complex-symmetric T3(2), 0<=alpha<1 only; no higher-dimensional extension claimed. Related Giri full manuscripts not independently inspected.
title: Sharp all-order extension for the third Toeplitz determinant of starlike functions
